# Donatello Italian Restaurant

> Italian Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Hand-made pasta every day, a jazz lounge next door and a staff that greets you like family.

- Phone: (813) 875-6660
- Address: 232 N Dale Mabry Hwy, Tampa, FL 33609
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: From the sea; Hand-made pasta; Veal, lamb and beef
- Rating: 4.5 from 1840 Google reviews
